title: Create and assign a task
beats: In this video, we'll create a task and hand it to a teammate.
Start with New task, at the top of the list.
Give it a short, clear title, like Update the pricing page.
Open Assignee, and choose who should own it. Priya runs design, so she's a good fit.
Set the priority to High, then click Create task.
The task lands at the top of the list, already assigned to Priya. Next, we'll give it a due date.
